ITEM 1 | Several thin, curled strips of cooked meat with crisp, browned edges and reddish-brown to golden tones, showing layered fat and lean streaks and a glossy, slightly oily sheen; the strips lie in an overlapping pile across the lower-center of the plate, roughly 12 cm long and 2 cm wide each, with a darker charred patch on the right strip | 22

ITEM 2 | Pale golden-yellow, translucent-edged fatty pieces tucked beneath and along the left side of the browned strips, with a soft, slightly glossy surface and rendered texture, forming a small cluster about 5 cm by 3 cm and about 0.5 cm thick | 8
